newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Macedonian deputy premier hurt in car crash.
newsitem.headline: Macedonian deputy premier hurt in car crash.

text.p: A car carrying Macedonia's deputy prime minister Jane Miljovski was involved in a road accident on Thursday 50 km (30 miles) from the capital Skopje, an eyewitness said.
"His Mercedes car crashed into a Lada on the highway and Miljovski was driven away," the witness said. He said the minister was bleeding but was able to walk.

Miljovski was formerly finance minister and in a previous government handled the privatisation agency. He has been one of the former Yugoslav republic's chief negotiators with the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank and foreign government and bank creditors.
